$schema_note: Canonical product seed data — Phase 2A analysis output. Not wired to any runtime code. See docs/catalogue/product-model.md.
source_count_note: docs/current-state/mock-data.md and docs/architecture/implementation-roadmap.md both state 28 products; actual src/lib/products.ts contains 26 (grep -c '{ id:' = 26). This is a documented discrepancy, see docs/catalogue/current-catalogue-audit.md.

products.description_en: Silky Swiss meringue buttercream on our signature vanilla sponge.

variants.note: Added 2026-08-01: previously this product had no real backend variant (product_type=simple) and its size picker on the product page was purely client-side decoration (defaultSizesByCategory/sizeOverridesById in src/routes/product.$id.tsx), which meant the price shown when a customer picked a size was never what the server would actually charge (see the product.$id.tsx fallback-size-delta-zeroing fix). This replaces that placeholder with a real, backend-priced Size variant per option, using the exact same price math the placeholder used to display (kept as the real, approved price rather than inventing a new one). Flavor stays decorative (no backend axis) for this product — it never had a price effect.

products.description_en: Three luscious layers of buttercream cake, finished with rainbow sprinkles and a cherry on top.

variants.note: Structural per-product variants as literally defined in src/lib/products.ts, restructured (2026-08-01) into combinatorial attribute axes so flavor is a real, separately priced/SKU'd variant dimension (previously flavor was decorative-only JSONB text with no price/SKU effect, D11 superseded). seed_service.py generates the Cartesian product of attributes[*].values as one catalogue_product_variants row per combination, with a catalogue_product_attribute_values row per axis (the identity this repo's Odoo variant importer adopts product.attribute/product.attribute.value ids into). Most other products instead fall back to category-level default size/flavor presentation options computed client-side in src/routes/product.$id.tsx (defaultSizesByCategory/defaultFlavorsByCategory) — those are NOT modeled here since they are UI presentation defaults, not persisted per-product data. See docs/catalogue/catalogue-decisions-required.md.
